title: Cassette 4 opening with James Patrick
summary: James Patrick introduces a musical session and asks about early teachers.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: My name is James Patrick, and I'm talking to Benny Carter. We're in Princeton, New Jersey, and it's October 14, 1976.

In this segment of the interview, we want to concentrate more on topics of specifically musical nature as opposed, perhaps to some of the more chronological or biographical things that have been discussed before, so that perhaps this segment of the interview will be somewhat more general with regard to dates, names and places and so forth. But we'll see.

So, we have to start somewhere, and I'd like to begin by just laying down perhaps a few factual type things about your early training, about some of your early teachers in New York, and perhaps some of the details what it was you gleaned from their instruction.

Now, in several biographical sketches about you, you mention 2 people in particular quite often; one was a man that you referred to as Mr. Michaels, and another one by the name of Arthur Reeves, and I'm wondering if you could tell us, first of all, about Mr. Michaels. Do you remember his first name?
